CDST 250.title: Introduction to Canada
CDST 250.description: Approaches to the study of Canada from an interdisciplinary perspective, including cultural, political, historical, and economic dimensions.

CDST 350.title: Canadian Studies
CDST 350.description: An interdisciplinary introduction to Canadian studies. Required of all Canadian Studies Majors.

CDST 450.title: Senior Seminar in Canadian Studies
CDST 450.description: The Canadian experience from a variety of disciplinary perspectives. Offered by the McLean Chair in Canadian Studies. Required of all Canadian Studies Majors.
